Application Data.NAME: Cycle City Bike Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cycle City Bike Shop specializes in the sales and service of high-quality bicycles, offering a wide range of products from renowned manufacturers. Our operations include retail sales of bicycles and accessories, along with professional maintenance and repair services utilizing manufacturer-approved parts. We prioritize safety and security with established physical measures, including surveillance cameras and secure display cases. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and promoting cycling as a healthy lifestyle choice within the community. We do not engage in rental or loaner bike programs, ensuring a focused and liability-conscious business model.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2022, a customer reported a theft of a high-end bicycle from our display area, which was valued at $2,000. The incident occurred due to a lack of immediate surveillance at the time, and it was reported to the police. The claim was processed, and the loss was covered under our existing insurance policy. Status: Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance cameras and secure display cases in place to deter theft and enhance safety.
